_help: Volunteer stories for stories.html, shown in this order: the volunteer's photo, then their words in a yellow card. Edit on GitHub (pencil icon), then commit: the site republishes itself. One story = one { } block, separated by commas. VOLUNTEERS ONLY: never a kid's story, name, age or photo here. Every real story needs the volunteer's written OK: put the month you got it in "consent" (like "2026-11"). "photo" is optional: a landscape photo of the volunteer (1200 x 900, under 200 KB, webp) in images/stories/; without one the page shows 'Photo coming soon'. "rating" (1 to 5 stars) is optional. While any story has "placeholder": true, the page stays out of search results and must not be linked from other pages: replace the placeholder blocks as real stories come in.

_example.name: First name, or first name + initial
_example.quote: What a session is like, a moment they remember, why they keep coming back. 40 to 80 words works best.
